recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless Pharmacy opens a new issue requesting a different current MedicationRequest or Dosage example.
issue_request: FHIR-7740 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request asking to add an example for MedicationPrescription.dosageInstruction.additionalInstructions when used as a CodeableConcept.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-7740 or the ballot item number was found. Historical commit af1b3adefa added MedicationPrescription examples including a coded SNOMED CT additionalInstructions example, and later commit 8175cd2686 added MedicationRequest dosage examples after the resource rename/refactor.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription is no longer an active current-build resource; source/fhir.ini lists MedicationRequest as active and records that MedicationPrescription became MedicationRequest. Current MedicationRequest examples include coded additionalInstruction CodeableConcepts, and Dosage.additionalInstruction remains CodeableConcept with coded-use guidance and an example SNOMED CT value set binding. FHIR-8603 independently supports that value set direction.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current source already satisfies the request, and adding another example or editing retired MedicationPrescription material would be redundant or out of build scope.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive with Modification issue added an exemplar SNOMED CT value set for additionalInstructions, consistent with current Dosage.additionalInstruction binding.
Same element family asked for an example value set and was marked duplicate/background to broader additionalInstructions value set work.
